ev.q: Players can construct houses, castles, and other buildings from the medieval era
Tiny Glade is a building simulator and sandbox
It does not include any tasks or story line that the player can follow and complete
Various critics have considered it a relaxing and cosy game
a small slice of flow state to pamper your brain
everything is awash in a pleasantly low-detail pastel goodness
with pleasant and charming aesthetic and big area for creativity
All objects in the game are medieval-styled
but noted the limited amount of content
